quarterly_data.quarter: Broadex Technologies results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (04-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Peh Kok Thye (2025 annual results briefing): the planned acquisition of Honghui Guanglian (Shanghai) is meant to position the company in upstream core optical-communication components through vertical integration; as the deal remains uncertain it is not expected to have a material effect on 2026 results. Board secretary Xiong Jun said the PD chips it uses in optical communications are currently bought externally, and that the company holds 60.45% of Changxinsheng with no current plan to acquire the rest.
